rules.forest_2000: Forest = Hansen tree canopy cover in 2000 of at least 30% (Global Forest Watch's default). Pixels are read every 4th row and column (~110 m) and weighted by their area on the WGS84 sphere approximation.
rules.loss: Loss = forest-2000 pixels with a loss year 2001–2025 (stand-replacing disturbance: clearing, fire, plantation harvest). Gross loss: regrowth and new plantations are not subtracted.
rules.loss_share: Share of the hex's 2000 forest lost 2001–2025; hexes with under 2 km² of 2000 forest have none.
rules.peak_year: The year with the most loss in the hex (earliest on ties); none when there is no loss.
rules.provinces: Province totals count each pixel in the province whose official province outline (OCHA COD-AB) holds it, so they don't depend on hex borders.

note: A relative indicator of trends, not an official statistic: the producers warn that Landsat sensors and the method changed over time (year-to-year steps can be artefacts) and that pixel counts are not definitive area estimates. Much loss in Vietnam is the harvest of plantations (acacia, rubber) that are replanted.
